data.input: Create a declarative contract file named contract.yaml in the workspace that defines a simple configuration with two resources: a text file named notes.txt and a directory named archive. Include a version field set to 1 and a description field.

content.newText:
# Declarative contract: desired state for two resources.
version: 1
description: Simple configuration declaring a text file for notes and a directory for archived items.
resources:
  - name: notes.txt
    type: file
    format: text
    state: present
  - name: archive
    type: directory
    state: present
